item.title: 【Live Audios (lossy)】MP3 - Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour - Japan 2025 (IEM)
item.description:
Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour - Japan 2025 (IEM)

Multi-Stereo IEM Matrix Recording

This is her first visit to Japan in three years, and she's steadily stepped up from Ariake Arena to a two-day concert at Saitama Super Arena. The thunderous cheers from the audience clearly demonstrate her popularity. While the XAVEL label released her previous Japan tour with superb sound quality, this time they've taken the recording to the next level. By combining the IEMs used by Billie and her crew onstage with the original ultra-high-quality audio source, we've achieved clarity comparable to that of a stereo soundboard recording. The click guides required for show progression, which are included in the IEM recording, have been largely removed, resulting in the same level of listenability as an official live recording. (There are a few small clicks, but they make up less than 1% of the total, so please forgive us.) The DVD contains footage of the performance, filmed in original full HD quality and converted to DVD format. The audio is also from the same source as the CD, resulting in excellent sound. The footage from the intro to the middle of "CHIHIRO" has been supplemented from online sources, but the rest of the video is completely original to the label. This, too, is well worth watching!
